name: Gyakusatsu
source:
May 3rd, 2000, the last Golden Week of the 20th century. Main character is a professional photographer. He arrives at Hanekawa-cho where he eavesdrops girls stories, then insults the girls and captures it all in the photography.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/12/vn-of-month-april-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
2000年5月3日，20世纪最后一个黄金周。主人公是一名专业摄影师，来到羽川町，偷听女孩们的谈话，随后羞辱她们，并将这一切拍进照片。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/12/vn-of-month-april-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
